preprocess_image_pairs: preprocess a pair of PIL images into grayscale, resized, and rescaled pixel values for keypoint matching
post_process_keypoint_matching: post-process LightGlue keypoint matching output into matched keypoints, scores, and indices filtered by threshold
visualize_keypoint_matching: visualize keypoint matches between image pairs by drawing colored lines and dots on a side-by-side plot
convert_to_grayscale: convert a torch.Tensor image to grayscale using the NTSC luminance formula
validate_and_format_image_pairs: validate and flatten a list of image pairs into a single list of valid images for processing
